858 :     timedelta_range : Return a fixed frequency TimedeltaIndex.
859 :     period_range : Return a fixed frequency PeriodIndex.
860 :     interval_range : Return a fixed frequency IntervalIndex.
861 : 
862 :     Notes
863 :     -----
864 :     Of the four parameters ``start``, ``end``, ``periods``, and ``freq``,
865 :     exactly three must be specified. If ``freq`` is omitted, the resulting
866 :     ``DatetimeIndex`` will have ``periods`` linearly spaced elements between
867 :     ``start`` and ``end`` (closed on both sides).
